verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a self-hosted deployment option for data residency. It keeps customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, prompts) in the customer's own cloud account and region, while Braintrust manages the UI and platform. Residency choice is therefore achieved only by deploying and running your own data-plane infrastructure. Missing for 10: a documented region selection for the managed/hosted service (e.g. US/EU), specifics on supported clouds and regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Data residency and compliance: Meet regulatory or contractual obligations by keeping all customer data ... within your own cloud account and region.
keeping all customer data (experiment logs, traces, datasets, and prompts) within your own cloud account and region
You deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your sensitive AI data, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, authentication, and platform updates.
